front: When did the Emancipation Proclamation take effect?

back: Gettysburg 1-3 July 1863; Vicksburg surrendered on 4 July 1863.

front: When and where did Lee surrender?
back: 9 April 1865, at Appomattox Court House, Virginia.

front: About how many Black soldiers served in the Union army?
back: About 180,000, around one in ten of the army by the end of the war.

front: Why did the North win the Civil War?
back: Greater resources, the blockade and Mississippi strategy, victories of 1863-64, emancipation and Black soldiers, Lincoln's leadership and Southern weaknesses.
